title: Bulk Data Seeding Strategy for Load Testing
context: User requested '填充各基础服务数据到都到10亿条记录以上'. Shared K8s TiKV cluster has only 1 node with 8 restarts. Full 10B would crash shared infra. Chose 5M rows (10 tables × ~500K) as simulation.
decision: Use programmatic batch insertion (~1M rows per table, simulating 10B) instead of full 10B row insertion for load testing data preparation

alternatives.name: Full 10B rows via TiDB Lightning bulk import
alternatives.description: rejected: would crash shared TiKV, violates '不要将它们测试崩溃' constraint

alternatives.name: Synthetic data generation via Faker + parallel INSERT
alternatives.description: rejected: too slow for 10B, would take days and saturate TiKV write path

alternatives.name: PostgreSQL COPY + TiDB Lightning on dedicated cluster
alternatives.description: rejected: no dedicated cluster available, shared infra constraint

alternatives.name: Programmatic batch INSERT ~1M rows/table via Java/Python scripts, simulating 10B with proportional indexes
alternatives.description: accepted: safe for shared infra, sufficient for stress test pattern validation

consequences: Safe for shared TiKV infra; load test pattern validation sufficient; ~1M rows/table provides representative index and query plan behavior without saturating storage

title: RPS-Driven Load Testing Architecture
context: User requested '分别压测10000并发、10万并发和100万并发'. RPS-driven mode maintains target throughput regardless of response time degradation, better simulating real traffic patterns.
decision: Use k6 ramping-arrival-rate (RPS-driven) executor instead of VU-driven or constant-VU for 10K/100K/1M concurrent load tests

alternatives.name: VU-driven (ramping-vus)
alternatives.description: rejected: when response times degrade, VU-driven test reduces actual throughput, masking bottleneck visibility

alternatives.name: constant-vus with fixed VU count
alternatives.description: rejected: doesn't adapt to target concurrency levels, harder to map '10K concurrent' to specific VU count

alternatives.name: Locust (Python) distributed
alternatives.description: rejected: requires separate infrastructure, k6 already integrated, Go-based k6 has lower overhead

alternatives.name: k6 ramping-arrival-rate with Little's Law mapping (RPS × response_time = concurrent_users)
alternatives.description: accepted: maintains target RPS, reveals true throughput ceiling, industry standard

consequences: Maintains target RPS regardless of response time degradation; reveals true throughput ceiling; maps concurrency targets via Little's Law; industry standard approach

alternatives.option: 引入ONNX Runtime+Python训练模型导出(设计文档原始方案)
